name: Edits change exactly the field proposed
purpose: A proposed edit to a spec or metric changes exactly the field it names, an addition is made once, an edit the records location holds for approval is reported as proposed, and an edit that cannot be applied changes nothing.
record: Sixteen written cases (evaluation/esoi_application/build_cases.py) over a small set of records and records locations: four edits that must apply to the field named (a spec, a metric, a quality profile, and a second field of a spec), eight that must be refused with the reason and leave every record unchanged (unknown target, field or kind, an empty value, an em dash, no target, an addition with no key, a location that refuses a write), one record added once, a repeat of an addition and of a milestone that adds nothing, and one edit that a records location holds for a person's approval and that is reported as proposed with the records unchanged. One number: the share of cases whose result and resulting records both equal what is expected.
disadvantages: The cases are written; an edit is checked for being the edit asked for, not yet for scoring no worse on the metric it touches.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the arm and its rival were recorded on the same cases]
command: esoi run esoi_application --impl record_field_edit; esoi run esoi_application --impl append_to_description
